title: Sleep Period (SP)
formula: Post-onset recording interval = TRT − sleep onset latency
alternateFormula: Same interval = TST + WASO (when WASO extends to lights on)
lesson: In these PSG reporting exercises, the requested interval runs from the first sleep epoch through lights on. Under the recording-boundary convention used here, it equals TRT minus sleep onset latency, or TST plus all wake after sleep onset through lights on. Some publications define sleep period time only until the final awakening; check the endpoint stated in each report before applying a formula.
memoryClue: Sleep period starts when sleep starts; it still includes later wake time.
coachBobNote: The endpoint matters: the questions here use lights on, not final awakening. Do not confuse the post-onset interval with total sleep time.

workedExample.prompt: TRT is 470 minutes and initial sleep latency is 25 minutes. Find the sleep period.

guided.prompt: TST 390 min and WASO 50 min. Find sleep period.

commonErrors.message: That is TST alone. Sleep period also includes wake after sleep onset.

guided.prompt: TRT 480 min and sleep latency 20 min. Find sleep period.
guided.success: Correct. The sleep period is 460 minutes.

definitionNote: PSG calculations in this module use the lights-out to lights-on recording interval and count WASO through lights on (AAST, 2021, §3.3.3.1). Other contexts may use different endpoints or denominators.
